snippet.title: Garden Ink | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Paint, merge, and explore! Garden Ink is a cozy sandbox/exploration game where you shape and grow your own world. Merging decorations and coloring tools help you customize your world. With hand-painted visuals and a soothing soundtrack, it’s time to discover every cute surprise.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3421740/Garden_Ink/


#indiegame #paint #cozy
